job.title: Interim Senior IT Category Manager
job.description:
Interim Senior IT Category Manager
West Sussex
Day Rate Inside IR35
Our Client, are looking to recruit an Interim Senior IT Category Manager to their Procurement team on an initial 6 months basis.
This is a busy and fast paced environment and you will have previous experience leading on IT Procurement in a complex environment to help drive operational excellence, drive value and ensure robust supplier performance.
As Interim Senior IT Category Manager you will:
Develop and own IT & Cyber category strategies aligned to the company’s business and technology objectives.
Lead end-to-end procurement activities across complex, high-value IT and Cyber categories.
Provide expert commercial support to Technology, Cyber, Digital, and wider business stakeholders.
Manage the full lifecycle of technology procurement including market engagement, sourcing, negotiation, and mobilisation.
Draft and negotiate commercial contracts ensuring alignment with risk, compliance, and operational needs.
Lead supplier relationship management, driving performance, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Ensure procurement activity adheres to overall governance, policies, and financial controls.
Maintain accurate category and supplier data across procurement systems.
Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Technology, and Cyber teams to deliver sourcing strategies.
Support continuous improvement of procurement processes and commercial frameworks.
Proactively manage commercial, operational, cyber, and supply-chain risk across IT & Cyber categories.



Suitable Candidates will bring:
Strong experience in IT procurement within large or complex organisations.
Strong understanding of commercial models including SaaS, cloud, managed services, licensing, and cyber solutions.
Proven track record delivering complex technology procurements and leading commercial negotiations.
Experience managing supplier performance, contracts, and service delivery frameworks.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with ability to influence senior stakeholders.
Evidence of continuous professional development in procurement, commercial, technology, or cyber domains.
Comfortable operating in an environment where policy is being developed and maturing gradually.
Preferred candidates will be based in the West Sussex area.
This is a day rate position. 3 days in the office, offered on an Inside IR35 basis.
Please get in touch to find out more.

job.title: IT Commercial and Risk Manager
job.description:
IT Commercial & Risk Manager
Remote
£80k - £90k plus benefits

ProcureOne are exclusively partnering a small business, with a large reach, to help them recruit a new IT Commercial & Risk Manager to their Senior team.

Reporting to the CEO, you will be responsible for leading the commercial relationship with their key technology vendor and other vendors, ensuring the seamless operation and continuous improvement supporting a critical platform. You will strike a balance between protecting the interests of the organisation while promoting a positive and trusting relationship with key suppliers.

You will also operate the company’s Risk Management Programme, working with risk-owners to ensure that key risks are identified and that controls and mitigations are in-place and appropriately monitored.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Strategic Vendor Management: Develop and maintain a strong, collaborative commercial relationship with the main technology vendor, fostering open communication and mutual trust, building towards a crucial negotiation in 2029.
  • Contract Governance: Oversee all aspects of the IT vendor contract, including performance monitoring, compliance tracking, and financial management.
  • Performance Optimization: Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure the vendor meets or exceeds service level agreements (SLAs). Identify areas for improvement and work with stakeholders to drive initiatives to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Risk Program Management: operate the company’s Risk Management Framework to ensure that they remain within risk appetite and correctly identify, control and mitigate new and emerging risks.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and assess potential risks associated with the vendor relationship and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Stakeholder Management: Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders, including technical teams, service delivery managers, and senior leadership, to ensure alignment and achieve shared objectives.
  • Continuous Improvement: Drive innovation and explore opportunities to leverage the vendor's expertise to enhance the functionality and value.
  • Incident Management: The successful IT Commercial & Risk Manager will be on the company rota for incident management.

You will be able to build strong relationships with key members of the team including CEO, Head of Operations, Head of Customer Experience and Head of Delivery

Suitable candidates will have recent senior level IT Vendor Management experience including:
 
  • Strong experience in commercial vendor management, preferably within the technology or telecommunications sector, managing risk programmes.
  • Demonstrated ability to negotiate, manage, and where required enforce complex contracts while at the same time fostering a sense of co-operation and partnership.
  • Technical Acumen: Solid understanding of IT infrastructure, software development, and cloud-based platforms.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and performance reporting.
  • Ability to build strong relationships, communicate effectively at all levels both verbally and in writing, and influence stakeholders.
  • The ability to take ownership. Must be comfortable with flexible boundaries and be excited about taking responsibility for issues and seeing them through to conclusion rather than rigidly staying within job descriptions.

This is a great opportunity to join a small organisation and have real impact. You will lead on IT Vendor Management and Risk Mitigation but also be comfortable tackling wider business tasks as required.

The Client is offering a competitive benefits package and flexible working. This is a remote based role with expectations to attend the London office as required (can be up to 3 times per month).

job.title: Interim Contract Management Lead
job.description:
Interim Contract Management Lead
London
Day Rate (outside IR35)

Our Client is running a large supply chain transformation programme and are now looking for an experienced Interim Contract Management Lead to design and embed practical, post-award contract and supplier management across Corporate Services, covering a supplier portfolio in excess of £100M.

This is a hands-on transformation role to build a fit for purpose Contract Management function through improved supplier governance, supplier segmentation, performance management and contract lifecycle management.

What you'll do
  • Review the current supplier landscape and contract management maturity, mapping ownership, governance and capability gaps.
  • Design end-to-end contract management processes and define boundaries between Procurement, Supply Chain and Contract Management.
  • Build supplier categorisation and tiering frameworks based on spend, risk, criticality and strategic importance, with proportionate governance for each tier.
  • Create practical tools including scorecards, KPI dashboards, risk registers, service review templates and a contract management playbook.
  • Set up a benefits tracking approach and identify opportunities for supplier rationalisation, spend consolidation and value improvement.
  • Produce presentations, workshops and communications for audiences from Executive Leadership to operational teams, articulating the case for change.
  • Pilot governance reviews with strategic suppliers and support a smooth transition into permanent ownership.
What you'll bring
  • Strong contract and supplier management expertise, ideally across Corporate Services or indirect categories.
  • A track record of designing operating models, governance frameworks and supplier segmentation in a transformation setting.
  • Confident stakeholder engagement and influencing skills at Executive level, with the ability to drive change without direct line management.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to produce clear, business-focused materials.
  • Must have previously built a Contract Management Framework before – not just managed Supplier Performance.
  • Experience in a public sector environment would be an advantage.
  • Must have UK right to work.

job.title: IT Professional Services Category Manager (3-6 months Contract)
job.description:
IT Professional Services Category Manager – 3-6 month Contract Role
USA – Remote Based
ProcureOne are working with a growing technology group to support them to recruit a contractor for a 3-6 month project to build their IT Professional Services Category Strategy.
Deliverables will include:
  • Assess the current landscape for the IT Professional Services Category through various mechanisms including analyzing historical spend, segmentation and contractual mapping.
  • Identify supplier fragmentation and supplier overlap
  • Drive stakeholder discovery meetings in order to manage and document pipeline, critical skill needs, supplier performance and operational constraints.
  • Build IT Professional Services Category Strategy, develop supplier rationalization model, benchmark rates, analyze market data, design the preferred supplier panel structure and rules of engagement, and quantify addressable spend and savings by value lever.
  • Execute sourcing and negotiation by running end to end tender process. Build rate card templates and pricing structures. Document awarded outcomes and negotiated savings.
  • Establish a supplier governance framework.
Suitable candidates will have proven IT Professional Services Category Management experience (eg Security, Consulting, Contingent Labor, Workforce Solutions).
You will have proven IT professional services category build experience – not purely maintenance of an inherited category.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate solid market knowledge of Professional services rate structures, markups, MSP/VMS commercial models.
You will have excellent data manipulation and stakeholder management experience – being able to build trust very quickly.
This project role is remote and can be based anywhere in the US. Must have US right to work.
